'''Teemto Pagalies's Podracer''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned by the [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Teemtos_Pod_Racer.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The circular cockpit module]]
The [[IPG-X1131 LongTail/Legends|IPG-X1131 ''LongTail'']] sported excellent traction and acceleration, able to achieve a maximum speed of 775 kilometers per hour. The pod's cockpit had a circular design, built around a gyroscopic stabilizer ring that rotated at 230 rpm. This ensured the otherwise-unaerodynamic Pod remained stable during flight.

==History==
[[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]] piloted this podracer in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the largest [[Podracing|podrace]] in the galaxy, during the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. While racing around the [[Canyon Dune Turn/Legends|Canyon Dune Turn]], his pod took a direct shot to the right engine by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Orr Agg R'orr]]. Pagalies survived the crash by rolling to safety in the circular cockpit. He later entered the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] with a podracer strikingly similar to his old one.

[[File:Pagalies_podracer.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The ''Longtail'' from the rear during the Boonta Eve Classic]]
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], an unidentified pilot ran (and won) the Boonta Eve Classic using a podracer that looked very similar to Pagalies', stacking a [[StarSpeeder 1000]] that inadvertently raced part of the third lap underneath it, apparently giving the StarSpeeder "twice the power".

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] acquired a podracer that looked very similar to Pagalies's. However, this was believed to be a mere replica, and not the same vehicle piloted by Pagalies.
